{{Top|leg}}
The '''prismatic crystal aligner''' was a tool used to maintain and repair a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon. It was used to remove and replace a blaster's [[Prismatic crystal/Legends|prismatic crystal]] housing. A prismatic crystal aligner was included in [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech's]] [[Blaster Repair Kit]].
